name: Skyline Trail, Paradise
why: A loop through flowering meadows to Panorama Point, face to face with the glaciers of Mount Rainier and with St. Helens, Adams and Hood on the horizon.
book: No permit. Timed-entry reservation for the Paradise corridor in summer (recreation.gov). Paradise parking fills by mid-morning.
water: Water at the Paradise visitor centre; none on the loop.
dangers: Snowfields above Panorama Point until late July: take the low route if unsure.
Fog hides the trail on the snow: people get lost every year.
Stay on the path: the meadows are fragile.

points.name: Paradise Inn
points.note: The 1916 lodge and the visitor centre at 1,650 m.

points.name: Myrtle Falls
points.note: A small waterfall below the mountain, a few minutes from the start.

points.name: Panorama Point
points.note: A rock terrace at 2,100 m under the Nisqually Glacier.

points.name: Golden Gate
points.note: Where the loop drops back through meadows of lupine and paintbrush.
